title: skip_confirm=true on a critical operation: no human confirmation registered
mechanism: The pending operation is classified critical (production deploy) but the caller passed skip_confirm=true, so no HumanConfirmation record was ever registered. I-20 fires: critical_operation is true and there is no confirmed record.
rationale: I-20 (human_confirmation_present) is the only hook whose predicate mentions human oversight: `critical_operation implies a confirmed HumanConfirmation`. A bypass flag that suppresses the confirmation prompt maps onto this predicate directly and onto nothing else — no capability is used undeclared, no trusted artifact diverges, and no suppression config exists. This is also the hook that neron_model deliberately does NOT repair: the corpus asserts that after degradation the operation remains blocked on I-20, because fabricating a confirmation would defeat the invariant. The neutralization therefore registers a granted confirmation out-of-band, which is the only legitimate way to clear the gate.

metadata.cwe: CWE-862: missing authorization (missing human oversight gate)
metadata.neutralization_semantics: Registering human_confirmation with confirmed=true. neron_model will never do this for you; it is an out-of-band human action, which is why neron stays blocked on I-20.
